title: The dispatcher routes multiple cron expressions to distinct handlers by expression match
asA: developer whose Worker needs to schedule two or more distinct workloads on distinct cron cadences
iWant: one dispatcher module that accepts an ordered map of {expression, handler} pairs and, on every scheduled invocation, routes to the matched handler with a bounded context {expression, scheduledTime, sink}
soThat: one wrangler.toml [triggers] crons block with multiple cron expressions maps cleanly to distinct handler code paths without hand-rolled conditionals

acceptanceCriteria.description: createDispatcher({routes, eventSink, skewToleranceMs, softBudgetMs, clock?}) returns a dispatch(event) function. Calling dispatch({cron, scheduledTime}) invokes exactly the handler whose expression string-equals the cron field, passes {expression, scheduledTime, sink} to it, and returns without invoking any other route's handler.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a dispatcher wired with two routes and two spy handlers
acceptanceCriteria.when: dispatch is called with a specific expression matching one route
acceptanceCriteria.then: only the matched spy handler is invoked exactly once with the bounded context

acceptanceCriteria.description: Calling dispatch({cron: expressionNotInRoutes, scheduledTime}) does NOT invoke any handler, fires a cronUnmatched event on the sink with metadata {event, expression, scheduledTime, outcome: unmatched, duration: 0} and returns without side effect.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a dispatcher wired with two routes and two spy handlers
acceptanceCriteria.when: dispatch is called with an expression not in the routes
acceptanceCriteria.then: no spy is called, a cronUnmatched event fires, and dispatch returns without side effect
